title: Image J Nerve Density Percentage Analysis
author: Elizabeth Smith
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.beh4jb8w

steps.title: Open image file
steps.instruction: In ImageJ select File → Open, locate the desired JPEG or TIFF image, and click to open it.

steps.title: Convert image to 8-bit
steps.instruction: Change image type to 8‑bit via Image → Type → 8‑bit.

steps.title: Remove overexposed areas
steps.instruction: Delete over‑exposed regions, scale bar, etc., by selecting the appropriate shape in the Shape Tool Bar (under the File Tool Bar) and clicking on the unwanted area.

steps.title: Set threshold for nerve density
steps.instruction: Open the Threshold dialog (Image → Adjust → Threshold), move both slider bars to the far right, then slowly slide the top slider left until the regions of interest turn red; record the percentage shown under the histogram as the nerve density percentage.

substeps.instruction: Move both sliders to far right
Slide top slider left until areas turn red

steps.title: Repeat and average measurements
steps.instruction: Reset the threshold sliders and repeat the measurement as many times as desired (commonly three times); calculate the average of the obtained percentages.
